CustomField.label: Consent to Contact
CustomField.description: Records whether the attendee has given explicit consent to be contacted for future charity communications at the point of registration. Defaults to false in compliance with GDPR opt-in requirements. Must only be set to true based on a clear and affirmative action by the attendee.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick only if the attendee has explicitly opted in to receive future communications from the charity. Leave unticked if consent was not given or is unclear.
